battle.name: 第二次土埃戰爭
battle.theater: 幼發拉底河至黎凡特海岸
battle.brief: 一八三九年四月，易卜拉欣帕夏越境進入敘利亞，六月二十四日在內齊布以炮火與騎兵擊潰奧斯曼軍，奪門百餘，敘利亞盡入埃及之手。一八四〇年英國地中海艦隊南下，炮擊貝魯特、賽伊達與阿克，終以條約把敘利亞退回蘇丹。卡面輪發手槍是那一代火燧手槍的祖型，只是個人佩槍，真正定勝負的是火炮與艦隊。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 交戰的兩邊同屬蘇丹的臣藩卻互不臣屬。一方是奧斯曼帝國本身，中央由蘇丹馬哈茂德二世於一八三九年春下令出兵敘利亞，前線由哈菲茲·穆罕默德帕夏率領的本部與庫爾德、阿拉伯部落的巴什巴祖克共同防守，炮兵中另有受雇的普魯士軍官任職。另一方是穆罕默德·阿里治下的埃及行省，軍隊由其子易卜拉欣帕夏統率，由歐洲式整編的尼扎姆線列步兵、阿扎布非正規步兵與馬穆魯克騎兵組成，參謀長是改宗的前法國軍官索利曼帕夏，另有數名歐洲教官分掌炮兵與工兵。戰局把歐洲列強拖下水：英國、奧地利與俄國結成干預同盟並出兵助奥斯曼，英國地中海艦隊還有普魯士與奧地利的分艦隊同行；法國與西班牙在政治上支援穆罕默德·阿里；敘利亞沿海的黎巴嫩山地勢力與巴希爾·沙哈卜二世捲入地方爭端，成為可以交易的一方。於是這場本屬蘇丹與埃及的家務事，變成列強在東地中海的第一次集體干預。
countriesEn: The two sides were both vassals of the same sultan and yet acknowledged no master but their own. On one side was the Ottoman Empire itself: in the centre the sultan Mahmud II ordered the invasion of Syria in the spring of 1839, and on the front the field army of Hafiz Mehmed Pasha was supported by Kurdish contingents and by Arab bashi-bazouks, with Prussian officers employed in the artillery. On the other side was the Egyptian province of Muhammad Ali, whose army was commanded by his son Ibrahim Pasha and composed of European-drilled nizam line infantry, azab irregulars and Mamluk cavalry, with the convert from the French officer corps, Soliman Pasha al-Faransawi, as chief of staff and several more European instructors in charge of the artillery and the engineers. The contest dragged the European powers in: Britain, Austria and Russia formed an intervention alliance and sent help to the Porte, and the British Mediterranean fleet was joined by small Austrian and Prussian squadrons; France and Spain supported Muhammad Ali politically; and the mountain chieftains of the Lebanese coast, with Bashir Shihab II, were drawn into the local struggle and became a party that could be bargained with. A family quarrel between the sultan and his Egyptian vassal thus became the first collective intervention by the powers in the eastern Mediterranean.
people: 穆罕默德·阿里是這場戰爭的推手，他以一八二〇年代以來在埃及建成的常備軍與歐洲式軍制作為資本，向蘇丹索取獨立；其子易卜拉欣帕夏是前線統帥，內齊布一戰的右翼迂迴與全線進攻都由他下令，勝後又依法國謀士之勸沒有乘勢進攻伊斯坦堡。哈菲茲·穆罕默德帕夏是奧斯曼方面的指揮，他奉命據險固守、等待敘利亞方面的內應，卻因為想參戰而擅自出擊，兵敗後退往馬什。普魯士上尉赫爾曼·馮·毛奇以觀察員身分隨奧斯曼軍赴前線，在哈菲茲身邊就炮兵部署提出意見，戰後寫成的《土耳其戰爭》成為近代軍事學的經典。索利曼帕夏是埃及軍的參謀長兼右翼指揮，內齊布一戰中收攏潰兵、扭轉危局。英方以海軍上將羅伯特·斯托普福德指揮地中海艦隊，准將查爾斯·納皮爾率分艦隊先行，納皮爾擅自與穆罕默德·阿里議和、又擅自封鎖亞歷山大，成為整場戰爭最具爭議的人物。蘇丹馬哈茂德二世在內齊布敗後數日病逝，十六歲的阿卜杜勒·邁吉德一世即位，帝國在最深的水位上換了君主。
peopleEn: Muhammad Ali was the man who drove the war: he had built a standing army and an European-style system in Egypt during the 1820s and used it as the bargaining counter for his independence. His son Ibrahim Pasha commanded in the field, ordered the turning movement on the right and the general attack at Nezib, and after the victory did not press on to Istanbul, on the advice of his French counseller. Hafiz Mehmed Pasha commanded for the Ottomans; he had orders to hold a strong position and wait for a rising in Syria, but wanting a battle of his own he disobeyed, and after the defeat fell back towards Marash. Captain Helmuth von Moltke the Elder accompanied the Ottoman army as an observer, advised Hafiz Pasha on the artillery and afterwards wrote The Russo-Turkish War, which became a classic of modern military literature. Soliman Pasha al-Faransawi was the Egyptian chief of staff and the commander of the right wing, and at Nezib it was he who rallied the broken troops and turned the battle. On the British side Admiral Sir Robert Stopford commanded the Mediterranean fleet and Commodore Charles Napier led the squadron in advance; Napier's unauthorized armistice with Muhammad Ali and his unauthorized blockade of Alexandria made him the most disputed figure of the whole war. Mahmud II died of illness a few days after the defeat at Nezib and was succeeded by the sixteen-year-old Abdülmecid I, and the empire changed its sovereign at the depth of its crisis.
kits: 卡面這件輪發手槍在戰場上只以它的後代出現。輪發機括在十六世紀初傳入西班牙並有本地匠人仿製，十七世紀脫胎為火燧機，到一八三九年，它已是軍官與近衛腰間那一代火燧手槍的祖型：埃及軍的軍官、馬穆魯克騎手與奧斯曼的巴什巴祖克都佩短管手槍，馬穆魯克另配馬槍與彎刀；奧斯曼普通士兵多帶火繩槍與舊式燧發滑膛步槍，埃及的尼扎姆步兵用新式燧發滑膛步槍配刺刀，站成線列。炮兵才是這場戰爭的真正主角：埃及軍在塞夫手上重整炮隊，用歐洲的分列射擊與成批訓練出來的炮手，內齊布一戰的火力密度遠高於對手；奧斯曼炮隊有普魯士與德國傭兵炮手，精度不差，卻在關鍵時刻因彈藥不足無法壓住對方。英國地中海艦隊的火力是另一套體系，靠皇家海軍新式炮術學校訓練出來的炮長，在數百米外打岸上城壘。阿克里城的守軍以舊牆加裝改的火炮防守，城南主火藥庫一旦被擊中就是整個防線最大的缺口。運輸靠駱駝隊與沿海的英國蒸汽船，敘利亞內陸的人員物資移動速度遠低於歐洲人的預期，這是遠征方最不習慣的一點。
kitsEn: On the battlefield the wheellock pistol on this card appeared only as its descendants. The wheel-lock mechanism reached Spain in the early sixteenth century and was copied by local smiths; in the seventeenth it turned into the flintlock, and by 1839 it was the ancestor of the generation of flintlock pistols worn at the belts of officers and guards. Egyptian officers, Mamluk riders and Ottoman bashi-bazouks all carried short-barrelled pistols, the Mamluk with a carbine and a curved sabre as well; ordinary Ottoman soldiers carried matchlocks and older flintlock smoothbore muskets, while the Egyptian nizam infantry carried new flintlock smoothbore muskets with bayonets and stood in line. The artillery was the real protagonist of the war. Sève had reorganised the Egyptian batteries with European divisions of fire and gun crews trained in batches, and at Nezib the weight of Egyptian fire was far greater than the enemy's; the Ottoman batteries, served by Prussian and German mercenary gunners, were accurate enough but could not hold the other side down when their ammunition ran short. British naval gunfire was a third system, laid down by gun captains drilled in the new gunnery school at HMS Excellent, firing at shore positions from several hundred metres. The garrison of Acre defended an old wall reinforced with modern guns, and the main magazine in the south of the city was the single greatest weakness in the whole line. Supply moved on camel caravans and by British steamers along the coast; inland in Syria everything moved far more slowly than Europeans expected, and that was the point at which the expedition was least at home.
tactics: 陸戰的樣子分兩段。前段是內齊布的迂迴：哈菲茲奉命據險固守、不可在平原上會戰，易卜拉欣卻在六月二十二日冒險渡過卡爾津河，繞到奧斯曼軍左翼背後，幾乎切斷其退往比雷季克的路；普魯士軍官力勸哈菲茲趁敵行軍時出擊或另擇陣地，他都沒有聽，直到二十三日夜間才下令全軍轉移，占領山脊而把後背對著原來的陣地，等於自己丟了退路與射界。二十四日早上八時開戰，埃及右翼在索利曼帕夏率領下左旋迂迴，炮兵對射把土耳其左翼打亂，易卜拉欣再以左翼騎兵衝鋒，衝鋒被火網擊退，埃及軍一度因彈藥告急而動搖，全靠炮兵補充彈藥與右翼整列才穩住；庫爾德與巴什巴祖克受不了炮火先逃，訓練有素的土耳其兵隨之崩潰，戰局在四小時內結束。後段在海上：一八四〇年英國分艦隊封鎖沿岸，十一月前完成貝魯特與賽伊達兩處的炮擊與登陸，朱尼耶的登陸點投入一千五百名土耳其兵與海軍陸戰隊，奈爾卡爾布的陣地攻擊由納皮爾指揮並擊退阿爾巴尼武裝，十一月三日至四日主力艦隊再攻阿克。
tacticsEn: The land fighting has two distinct shapes. The first is the turning movement at Nezib. Hafiz had orders to hold a strong position and not to risk a general action in the plain; Ibrahim instead forced the Karzin river on 22 June and turned the Ottoman position, threatening the road back to Birecik, and the Prussian officers urged Hafiz either to attack the Egyptians while they were marching or to occupy new ground and deny the crossing, but he did neither, and only on the night of 23 June ordered a general movement onto the heights with his rear facing his old positions, throwing away both his line of retreat and his field of fire. The battle opened at eight in the morning of 24 June: the Egyptian right under Soliman Pasha wheeled left to outflank, the batteries' return fire disordered the Ottoman left, Ibrahim charged with the cavalry of the left wing, the charge was broken by fire, and the Egyptian army wavered when its ammunition ran low, until the batteries were resupplied and the right wing was re-formed in line. The Kurds and the bashi-bazouks could not bear the bombardment and ran first, the trained Ottoman infantry broke after them, and the action was over within four hours. The second shape is at sea: in 1840 the British squadron blockaded the coast, bombarded and landed at Beirut and Sidon before November, put fifteen hundred Turkish troops and marines ashore at Jounieh, and at Nahr al-Kalb attacked the Egyptian positions under Napier, beating back the Albanian irregulars; on 3 and 4 November the main fleet then came up against Acre.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。內齊布一戰在一八三九年六月二十四日上午八時開打，約四小時結束，兩軍各約四萬人：埃及軍死傷約三千，奧斯曼軍死傷約四千，並丟下約一百門火炮與全部輜重。英國干預的海上數字也有記錄：攻阿克時主力艦自四百五十至八百米外射擊，艦隊共發射約四萬八千發炮彈；十六時二十分一枚炮彈擊穿城南主火藥庫並引爆，約一千一百名守軍當場陣亡，英軍僅死十八人、傷四十一人；此前在貝魯特、賽伊達與奈爾卡爾布的炮擊中英軍亦有傷亡。埃及在敘利亞的駐軍在一八四〇年夏被估為約一萬五千人，納皮爾在朱尼耶投入的登陸兵力為一千五百名土耳其兵與海軍陸戰隊。條約部分：一八四〇年八月《倫敦公約》訂下框架，穆罕默德·阿里在十一月二十七日接受；最終條款把埃及常備軍限為一萬八千人，敘利亞、克里特、漢志與阿達納歸還蘇丹，埃及歸還艦隊，並以敘令確認穆罕默德·阿里家族對埃及的世襲總督權。各方記述在兵員與傷亡數字上仍有出入，引用時宜保留其說法而非取其一。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The battle of Nezib was fought on the morning of 24 June 1839, beginning at eight o'clock and over in about four hours, with about forty thousand men on each side: Egyptian dead and wounded about three thousand, Ottoman dead and wounded about four thousand, with about a hundred guns and the whole baggage train left on the field. The British intervention has figures of its own. Against Acre the ships fired from four hundred and fifty to eight hundred metres and the fleet discharged about forty-eight thousand rounds; at twenty minutes past four in the afternoon a shell penetrated the main magazine in the south of the city and detonated it, killing about eleven hundred of the garrison, while the British lost eighteen killed and forty-one wounded; there were British casualties too in the earlier bombardments of Beirut, Sidon and Nahr al-Kalb. The Egyptian force in Syria was put at about fifteen thousand in the summer of 1840, and the landing at Jounieh comprised fifteen hundred Turkish troops and marines. On the treaty: the Convention of London of August 1840 set the framework, Muhammad Ali accepted it on 27 November, and the final terms limited the Egyptian standing army to eighteen thousand men, returned Syria, Crete, the Hejaz and Adana to the sultan, handed back the fleet, and confirmed by firman the hereditary governorship of Egypt to the family of Muhammad Ali. Accounts differ on the strength and casualty figures, and it is better to keep the disagreement visible than to pick one side.
cause: 起因是穆罕默德·阿里與蘇丹之間十一年未解的權力糾葛。一八三三年《屈塔希亞和約》讓埃及取得敘利亞的管理權，卻把蘇丹的屈辱釘在文本裡；穆罕默德·阿里此後要的是世襲與實質獨立，蘇丹馬哈茂德二世則要收回敘利亞、恢復帝國威信，雙方都摸得清對方的底牌。外部壓力把矛盾推到臨界：敘利亞在埃及高壓統治下連年起義，一八三四年賽伊達事變、一八三四年至三五年敘利亞農民起義、一八三八年德魯茲人起義，都削弱了埃及的佔領；一八三八年《巴爾塔里曼條約》簽訂，英國取得在帝國水域干預的權利，穆罕默德·阿里一方拒絕接受條約附帶的條件，蘇丹便以為時機成熟，於一八三九年春下令出兵敘利亞。列強的算計更關鍵：英、奧、俄要保住通向印度的航路與君士坦丁堡的均勢，法國則把穆罕默德·阿里視為削弱英國在中東的工具，於是出現了少數歐洲國家組成的干預聯盟。正是這支聯盟把一場邊疆戰爭推成了歐洲的海上危機，也把原本可以談判收場的戰事拖成了兩年的消耗。
causeEn: The cause lay in the power struggle between Muhammad Ali and the sultan, unresolved for eleven years. The Convention of Kütahya of 1833 gave Egypt the administration of Syria but nailed the sultan's humiliation into the text; after that Muhammad Ali wanted hereditary rule and real independence, while Mahmud II wanted Syria back and the authority of the empire restored, and each could read the other's hand. Outside pressure pushed the contradiction to the edge. Syria rose repeatedly under Egyptian rule, with the Sidon affair of 1834, the Syrian peasant revolt of 1834-35 and the Druze revolt of 1838, all of which weakened the occupation. The Treaty of Balta Liman of 1838 gave Britain the right to intervene in imperial waters; Muhammad Ali's side refused the conditions attached to it, and the sultan judged the moment ripe, ordering his troops into Syria in the spring of 1839. The calculations of the powers mattered still more. Britain, Austria and Russia wanted the sea road to India and the balance at Constantinople preserved; France saw Muhammad Ali as a means of weakening Britain in the eastern Mediterranean; and an intervention alliance of a few European states was formed. It was that alliance which turned a frontier war into a maritime crisis in Europe and dragged a conflict that might have been negotiated into two years of attrition.
impact: 後果第一層在埃及：敘利亞雖失，埃及換來世襲總督權與一支規模受制卻仍精銳的常備軍，此後十多年裡軍制、炮兵與歐洲教官體系不斷擴充，軍隊成為穆罕默德·阿里家族維持對內對外權力的柱石；一八四八年易卜拉欣病故、一八四九年穆罕默德·阿里病故之後，總督權仍傳給後裔，直至一八七九年。第三層在奧斯曼：一八三九年的蘇丹更替與列強集體干預，讓帝國第一次在歐洲眼中成為值得聯手保護的對象，也讓瓜分的選項開始出現在外交計算裡。第四層在英國：地中海艦隊遠征黎巴嫩、封鎖亞歷山大，把皇家海軍的炮術與蒸汽船推到歐洲內海的現場，也把為條款而開火的做法推上外交舞臺，此後對西班牙、意大利與拉丁美洲的干涉都沿用同一套路。第五層在敘利亞：埃及撤走後，地方分權反而加劇，黎巴嫩山地與沿岸城鎮在干預期間嘗試過武裝自治；阿克在十一月陷落，則成了沿海各城之後反覆被引用的榜樣。
impactEn: The consequences came in layers. For Egypt, the loss of Syria was paid for with the hereditary governorship and a standing army that was limited in size but not in quality; through the following decade the drill system, the artillery and the corps of European instructors were expanded, and that army became the pillar of the family's power at home and abroad. Ibrahim died in 1848 and Muhammad Ali in 1849, yet the governorship passed to his descendants and survived until 1879. For the Ottomans, the change of sultan in 1839 and the collective intervention of the powers showed the empire for the first time that it was worth acting for as a whole, and the option of partition began to appear in diplomatic calculation. For Britain, the expedition to the Levant and the blockade of Alexandria carried the new naval gunnery and the steam ship into the waters of Europe, and put the practice of firing for the sake of a clause on the diplomatic stage, a practice repeated later in Spain, in Italy and in Latin America. For Syria, the departure of the Egyptians left the province to the sultan but strengthened local particularism, and the mountain chieftains and the coastal towns experimented with armed self-government during the intervention; the fall of Acre in November became the example afterwards quoted against the coastal cities.
result: 結果是埃及在戰場上贏、在政治上輸。內齊布的勝利使敘利亞全境歸埃及，蘇丹的艦隊整體倒向穆罕默德·阿里，帝國一度只剩蘇丹直属的土地與列強的保護；一八三九年七月《溫基亞—斯克萊西條約》把英國援助寫成蘇丹的正式義務，干預的機器由此開動：一八四〇年英國分艦隊封鎖沿岸、炮擊貝魯特與賽伊達、登陸協同作戰，十一月三日至四日主力艦隊攻阿克，十六時二十分的炮彈引爆城內火藥庫，守軍覆沒，阿克易手。回到外交桌面，十一月穆罕默德·阿里接受《倫敦公約》的框架，一八四一年的正式條約確認他對埃及的世襲總督權，條件是交出敘利亞、克里特、漢志與阿達納、歸還艦隊，並把常備軍限為一萬八千人。戰爭以埃及保住埃及、失去敘利亞告終；奧斯曼王朝在歐洲列強的援手下記住了帝國的殘局，而英國在東方學到最重要的一課是：沒有艦隊，海權國家在東地中海就沒有發言權。
resultEn: The result was a military win for Egypt and a political defeat. The victory at Nezib put the whole of Syria in Egyptian hands and the Ottoman fleet went over bodily to Muhammad Ali, leaving the empire with little beyond the sultan's own provinces and the protection of the powers. The Convention of Unkiar Skelessi of July 1839 turned British assistance into an explicit obligation of the sultan, and the machinery of intervention began to work: in 1840 the British squadron blockaded the coast, bombarded Beirut and Sidon and landed in support of the Turks, and on 3 and 4 November the main fleet came against Acre, where a shell at twenty minutes past four in the afternoon detonated the magazine and the garrison was destroyed and the city changed hands. Back at the negotiating table, Muhammad Ali accepted the framework of the Convention of London in November, and the formal treaty of 1841 confirmed his hereditary governorship of Egypt on condition that he surrender Syria, Crete, the Hejaz and Adana, return the fleet and limit his standing army to eighteen thousand men. The war ended with Egypt keeping Egypt and losing Syria; the Ottoman dynasty saved what was left of the empire with the help of the European powers; and the lesson Britain took east of Suez was the simplest one: without a fleet, a maritime power has no voice in the eastern Mediterranean.
